subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs-generation PR should be the canonical implementation path for this issue?
rationale: The requested work remains missing on current main, but two open conflicting PRs overlap and choosing between adopting, repairing, or replacing them is maintainer routing rather than a new automated fix job.

options.title: Refresh stronger proven sibling
options.body: Refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 on current main, resolve conflicts, rerun proof, and use it as the canonical fix.

options.title: Repair same-author closing PR
options.body: Ask https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91612 to resolve its proof and formatter concerns, resolve conflicts, and land that branch instead.

options.title: Request one replacement
options.body: Close or pause the competing PRs and request one focused replacement if neither branch is worth adopting.

recommendation.title: Refresh stronger proven sibling
recommendation.body: Refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 on current main, resolve conflicts, rerun proof, and use it as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent stabilization history on the credential matrix docs surface and is the best available routing owner for choosing between overlapping implementation PRs.
